path.description: PART 12 §40: RFC 6901 pointer into the accompanying canonical AST, as in §38. The binding for THIS tree only.

offset.description: PART 12 §40: codepoints per §4, counted from the start of the addressed node's own text.

id.description: PART 12 §40: the holder's own id for the annotation, unique within a sidecar. Not attrs.id and not a §38 node id.

kind.description: PART 12 §40: what the range annotates, an open vocabulary matched by equality. A kind core does not define is qualified as in §34.

data.description: PART 12 §40: the holder's payload, opaque to core. Nothing in Carve reads it.
